# Regex Ai MCP

> regex-ai-mcp MCP — AI-powered automation tool

`regex-ai-mcp` is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server by MEOK AI Labs.

## Install

```bash
pip install regex-ai-mcp
```

Or run without installing:

```bash
uvx regex-ai-mcp
```

## Tools

- `build_regex` — Build common regex patterns. Types: email, url, phone, ipv4, date_iso, hex_color, credit_card, ssn, zip_us, uuid. Or describe a custom pattern.
- `test_regex` — Test a regex pattern against a string. Flags: i(gnorecase), m(ultiline), s(dotall).
- `explain_regex` — Explain a regex pattern in plain English.
- `extract_matches` — Extract all matches of a pattern from text. group=0 for full match, 1+ for capture groups.
